name: tool-papa-brume-htcxvfcr
description: Brume's optional breathing break. brume_reset starts a short guided break; brume_complete saves the session record and your reflection when the user says done. Brume's result — the conversation-preparation card — lives in the app window, where the person reads and saves it themselves.
author: Brume

tools.name: brume_reset
tools.description: Optional breathing break, not Brume's result. Start (or continue) a short guided break, rendered verbatim to the user. Before calling, plan it yourself from what the user said: choose `pattern` (cyclic-sigh: 2s in, 1s top-up, 6s out — right before something tense or when keyed up; long-exhale: 4s in, 6s out — a gentle reset between tasks; box: 4s in, 4s hold, 4s out, 4s hold — getting ready for focused work; steady: 5.5s in, 5.5s out — winding down) and `seconds` (60, 90, 120 or 180; 60 if they have little time), and write `title`, `opening`, `cues` and `why`. Describe only the rhythm and how it fits their moment — never effects on the body, brain, stress, sleep or health. The returned script is shown verbatim; do not restate it. If the user asks to change pace mid-break, call again with `pace` and `remaining_seconds` (the plan is kept). When the user says they are done, call brume_complete.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: What the user said they are doing or about to do, as a short phrase. Never invent one.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Up to 6 words naming this break.

parameters.name: opening
parameters.description: One or two calm sentences (max 30 words) responding to what they said.

parameters.name: cues
parameters.description: 2–3 short phrases (max 8 words each) about posture or attention, shown during the break. Never counts, timings, or the words in, out, hold, inhale, exhale.

parameters.name: why
parameters.description: One sentence (max 20 words): which part of their note this rhythm fits, describing only the rhythm.

parameters.name: pace
parameters.description: Tempo factor: slow = 1.25x phase length, normal = 1x, fast = 0.8x. Default normal.

parameters.name: remaining_seconds
parameters.description: Deliver only roughly this many more seconds — use when re-invoking to change pace mid-break so the script covers just the remainder (partial cycles allowed). Overrides the planned length.

parameters.name: cycles
parameters.description: Legacy override: exact breath cycles to deliver. Ignored when seconds is given.

tools.name: brume_complete
tools.description: Close out a guided break after the user says they are done. Write `reflection` yourself: at most 2 sentences and 35 words — first acknowledge how it went in plain words (matter-of-fact if they ended early or still feel wired, never guilt), then one concrete next step tied to what they said they are doing next. No emoji, no health claims, and do not mention breathing science. Pass `felt` only if the user said how they feel. The reflection is shown verbatim; do not repeat it. Do not call for abandoned breaks.

parameters.name: felt
parameters.description: Only if the user said how they feel.

parameters.name: reflection
parameters.description: Your closing note, written as described above.
